jsonencode.description: Encodes a value as JSON when the document is used.

loop.description: Repeats the body once per item of the collection: a map body yields a map, a list body of one element yields a list.

arguments.name: in
arguments.description: The collection, a list or a map.

arguments.name: body
arguments.description: What each pass yields: a map's entries, or a list's one element.

arguments.name: for
arguments.description: The loop variables: one binds each item, two bind each key or index and its value.

merge.description: Merges maps, each content over the one before it.

arguments.name: contents
arguments.description: The maps to merge, in order.

ref.description: A reference to an entry, `ref <type>.<name>`, or to one of its fields, `ref <type>.<name>.<field>`.

local.description: A named value from the document's `locals:` block, `local.<name>`, standing for the whole value.

literal_string.description: A plain string that is not a `ref` or a bare `local`.

string_or_ref.description: A literal string, a `ref`, or a bare `local`.

string_list_or_ref.description: A list of (literal string | `ref` | `local`), or a single `ref` or bare `local` resolving to a whole list.

string_map_or_ref.description: A map of string to (literal string | `ref` | `local`), or a single `ref` or bare `local` resolving to a whole map.

version.description: [required] The version of the components every entry uses.

locals.description: Named values the document references as `local.<name>`.

visibility.description: [required] How long a received message stays hidden, in seconds.

kms_key.description: [optional] The key messages are encrypted with.

consumers.description: [optional] The services that read the queue.

dead_letter.description: [optional] The queue failed messages move to.

outputs.description: The values the stack exports, by name.
